name: Blinn-Phong Toon Shading
definition: Toon-shaded variant of Blinn-Phong that posterizes diffuse lighting and harshly cuts specular reflections.
summary: Blinn-Phong Toon Shading is a non-photorealistic model that discretizes diffuse lighting into bands and applies binary thresholding to specular highlights, creating distinct color levels.
